body.x: ISON will participate in the world’slargest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 toshowcase its drone charging port and drone station.

ISON introduced the company as "Droneautonomous flight solution company, a startup venture company established in2016 with the goal of improving drone stations and autonomous flight solutionsto improve public well-being and quality of life."

The official continued, “We are preparingfor globalization based on our knowledge, and we are aiming to launch the droneautomatic charging port (C-Port) in 2019 and the unmanned charging andcontainment drone station (D-Station) in the first half of 2020."

When asked about the differentiation of the drone station, the official said, "Our drone station features the fastest and safest charging method with a hangar that protects the drone and a lifting pole that is easy to operate and maintain.

The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS has reported the most news on CES, MWC, and IFA, the world's three major tech exhibitions for the past 13 years. It is sending special reporters to CES this year to report major issues in the global market and introduce outstanding Korean companies to the world.
